}}'''Jamilila Norsish''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jamilila Norsish}}

== History ==
She is very weak in the [[One Power]] and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

== Activities ==
She disappears from the [[White Tower]] after [[Egwene al'Vere]] becomes [[Amyrlin Seat]] and asks all Aes Sedai to re-swear the [[Three Oaths]] on the [[Oath Rod]]. This strongly suggests she is [[Black Ajah]], even though her name was not on [[Verin Mathwin|Verin's]] list. Egwene also thought she might possibly be [[Mesaana]].

Another possibility is that she was taken by the [[Seanchan]].
